name: KanDeck AI Chat — Webhook + Auth + Agent

nodes.name: KanDeck Chat Webhook
nodes.notes: KanDeck's chat widget POSTs here. This node's path + your n8n base URL form the Production URL you paste into KanDeck -> App Settings -> AI Chat -> Webhook URL, e.g. https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/kandeck-chat. allowedOrigins:'*' lets the browser call it (CORS). Requests continue to 'Check Auth', which requires the Authorization: Bearer <token> header.

nodes.name: Check Auth
nodes.notes: AUTH GATE. Replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_TOKEN with a long random secret (keep the 'Bearer ' prefix here) and set the SAME token — value only, no 'Bearer ' — in KanDeck's App Settings -> AI Chat -> Bearer token. True -> continue to the agent; False -> 401. Generate one with: openssl rand -base64 32

nodes.name: Reject Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Returned when the Authorization header doesn't match. Keeps random/scanner traffic off your LLM before any work runs.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Pulls the fields out of the webhook body into a flat shape. KanDeck sends { source:'kandeck', sessionId, message, timestamp } as JSON — on the Webhook node that arrives under $json.body.

nodes.name: AI Agent

options.systemMessage:
You are the assistant embedded in KanDeck, a personal Trello-style kanban app. Help the user think through their tasks, boards, and priorities. Answer clearly and concisely. You are talking to a single user; use the provided memory to keep track of the conversation.

Note: KanDeck does not send your board contents in the request. If you want to answer questions about specific cards, add a tool to this agent that calls KanDeck's REST API (GET /api/boards, /api/search?q=...) with an API key.

nodes.notes: The assistant. Its reply lands in $json.output. To let it actually read the user's cards, attach an HTTP Request tool pointed at KanDeck's REST API (send X-API-Key). Any chat model works — wire your preferred one into the model input below.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: Attach YOUR OpenAI credential and pick a model. Any chat-model node works (Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama, etc.) — just wire it into the AI Agent's model input.

nodes.name: Simple Memory
nodes.notes: Keys conversation memory by KanDeck's sessionId, so each browser keeps an isolated context. KanDeck sends a stable per-browser sessionId; the widget's 'Clear conversation' button rotates it.

nodes.name: Respond to KanDeck
nodes.notes: JSON response back to the widget: { reply, sessionId }. KanDeck reads 'reply' first (it also accepts output/text/message/response/answer/content, unwraps arrays and json/data envelopes, and takes plain text).

parameters.content:
## KanDeck AI Chat

**One webhook -> auth gate -> AI agent -> JSON reply.**

1. **KanDeck Chat Webhook** receives `{ source:'kandeck', sessionId, message, timestamp }` from the browser widget.
2. **Check Auth** compares the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header to your secret. Mismatch -> **Reject Unauthorized** (401).
3. **Normalize** flattens the body; the **AI Agent** (with **Simple Memory** keyed by `sessionId`) answers; **Respond to KanDeck** returns `{ reply }`.

Setup: attach your OpenAI credential, replace `REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_TOKEN` in **Check Auth** with a random secret and paste the same value into KanDeck's App Settings -> AI Chat, confirm the webhook path, then **Activate**.

Want it to know your cards? Give the agent an HTTP Request tool that calls KanDeck's REST API (`/api/search`, `/api/boards`) with an `X-API-Key`.
